en.title: M5Stack Official M5GO IoT Starter Kit V2.7
bullets: Comprehensive IoT Starter Kit: The M5GO IoT Starter Kit v2.7 is a cost-effective development kit that includes the Core Controller M5GO and six expansion units with various functions. This kit provides everything you need to kickstart your IoT projects, including sensors, actuators, and splitters.

Powerful ESP32 Development Platform: The Core Controller M5GO is based on the ESP32 chip, featuring two low-power Xtensa 32-bit LX6 microprocessors with a main frequency of 240MHz. With 16MB FLASH memory, it supports larger program sizes, making it ideal for complex IoT applications.

Integrated HD IPS Display and Hardware Peripherals: The kit includes an integrated 2.0-inch HD IPS display panel and various hardware peripherals. This allows for a rich user interface and interaction, enhancing the usability and functionality of your IoT projects.

Compatibility and Expandability: The M5GO IoT Starter Kit v2.7 offers compatibility with M5Stack stacking modules and sensors, providing a wide range of resources and expandability options. The base is also compatible with 8mm size LEGO blocks, allowing for creative and customizable structures.

Versatile Development Platforms: This kit supports multiple development platforms, including UIFlow, MicroPython, A rduino, and .NET nanoFramework. Whether you prefer graphical programming or traditional coding, the M5GO IoT Starter Kit v2.7 accommodates your preferred development style.

specs.Built-In Media: 1x M5GO, 6x Expansion Units (ENV III, IR, RGB, PIR, ANGLE, HUB), 4x LEGO Blocks, 12x LEGO Connections, 4x GROVE Cables, 1x Type-C USB Cable (20cm), 1x Quick Start Guide
specs.Item Highlight: ESP32 IoT kit with 2.0" display, 6 sensor units, Wi-Fi, 16MB Flash, mic & speaker, for STEM & smart home projects.

en.headline: An ESP32 IoT starter kit with a 2.0 in display and six expansion units
en.intro: The M5GO IoT Starter Kit V2.7 pairs the ESP32-based M5GO core controller, with its 2.0 in HD IPS display, with six expansion units that include sensors, actuators and splitters. FeelBetter orders it from the US seller after you check out and ships it to Korea, typically 7–14 business days after ordering, with tracking sent by email.
highlights: The M5GO core controller runs on an ESP32 chip with two low-power 32-bit Xtensa LX6 processors at 240 MHz.
16 MB of Flash memory supports larger programs for more complex IoT applications.
An integrated 2.0 in HD IPS display and onboard peripherals, including a mic and speaker, allow a richer interface.
Six expansion units (ENV III, IR, RGB, PIR, ANGLE and HUB) come in the box, with four Grove cables and a 20 cm Type-C USB cable.
It supports UIFlow, MicroPython, Arduino and .NET nanoFramework, and the base is compatible with 8 mm LEGO blocks.

sections.p: The kit contains one M5GO controller, six expansion units (ENV III, IR, RGB, PIR, ANGLE and HUB), four LEGO blocks, twelve LEGO connections, four Grove cables, a 20 cm Type-C USB cable and a quick start guide. It is described as a cost-effective way to start IoT projects with sensors, actuators and splitters.

You can program it graphically with UIFlow or write code in MicroPython, Arduino or .NET nanoFramework. It works with M5Stack stacking modules and sensors, and the base is compatible with 8 mm LEGO blocks for custom structures. The listing positions it for STEM and smart home projects.

cautions: The contents list a 20 cm Type-C USB cable only; no power adapter is listed.

ko.intro: ESP32 기반 M5GO 코어 컨트롤러에 2.0인치 HD IPS 디스플레이가 들어 있고, 센서·액추에이터·분배기를 포함한 확장 유닛 6개가 함께 와요. 주문하시면 FeelBetter가 미국 판매처에서 구매해 한국으로 보내드리고, 보통 주문 후 영업일 기준 7~14일 걸리며 배송 추적 정보는 이메일로 안내해 드려요.
highlights: M5GO 코어 컨트롤러는 ESP32 칩 기반으로, 저전력 Xtensa 32비트 LX6 프로세서 2개가 240MHz로 동작해요.
16MB 플래시 메모리라 더 큰 프로그램도 올릴 수 있어 복잡한 IoT 응용에 알맞아요.
2.0인치 HD IPS 디스플레이와 마이크·스피커 등 내장 주변장치로 풍부한 인터페이스를 만들 수 있어요.
ENV III, IR, RGB, PIR, ANGLE, HUB 확장 유닛 6개와 Grove 케이블 4개, 20cm USB Type-C 케이블이 들어 있어요.
UIFlow, MicroPython, Arduino, .NET nanoFramework로 개발할 수 있고, 베이스는 8mm LEGO 블록과 호환돼요.

sections.p: M5GO 본체 1개, 확장 유닛 6개(ENV III, IR, RGB, PIR, ANGLE, HUB), LEGO 블록 4개, LEGO 연결부 12개, Grove 케이블 4개, 20cm USB Type-C 케이블 1개, 빠른 시작 안내서가 들어 있어요. 센서, 액추에이터, 분배기로 IoT 프로젝트를 시작하기에 알맞은 가성비 키트라고 소개돼요.
UIFlow로 그래픽 프로그래밍을 하거나 MicroPython, Arduino, .NET nanoFramework로 코드를 쓸 수 있어요. M5Stack 스태킹 모듈·센서와 호환되고, 베이스는 8mm LEGO 블록과 맞아서 원하는 구조물을 만들 수 있어요. 상품 정보에서는 STEM 학습과 스마트홈 프로젝트용으로 소개해요.

cautions: 구성품 목록에는 20cm USB Type-C 케이블만 있고 전원 어댑터는 적혀 있지 않아요.
